name: Netroar TaskFlow
tagline: The Next-Gen Cyber-Acrylic Productivity & Gamified Task Ecosystem
description: Netroar TaskFlow (formerly Netroar To-Do) is a high-performance productivity suite engineered for creators, gamers, and engineers. It combines precision countdown timers, an RPG gamification engine with XP and rewards, seamless cross-device cloud synchronization, and a stunning cyber-acrylic visual interface.
features: Cyber-Acrylic glassmorphism with high-contrast Neon Mint accents
RPG Gamification engine with XP gain, level ups, and milestone rewards
Offline-first local cache with instant Google Cloud Firestore synchronization
Live sprint timers, deadline alerts, and Pomodoro focus stopwatch
Universal cross-platform access across Windows, Android, and Web browsers

name: Netroar Axon Assistant
tagline: Intelligent Neural Voice Assistant & System Automator
description: Netroar Axon is an ultra-fast Android and desktop smart assistant powered by hybrid on-device voice recognition and cloud neural intelligence. It executes complex device commands, drafts thoughts, manages tasks, and automates workflows with a responsive cybernetic HUD.
features: Low-latency voice activation and on-device natural speech processing
Smart system command execution and contextual workflow triggers
Privacy-centric offline voice transcription modes
Custom customizable hotwords and cybernetic HUD interface

name: Netroar Bridge
description: Bridge the gap between Windows PC and Android smartphones. Netroar Bridge provides instant real-time clipboard sharing, biometric notifications mirroring, and zero-compression high-speed local Wi-Fi file drops without cloud latency.
features: Zero-configuration peer-to-peer local network discovery
Instant two-way clipboard copy-paste sync across PC and phone
End-to-end encrypted Wi-Fi direct file transfer with drag-and-drop
Remote media controls and synced notification dismissals

name: Netroar Store
tagline: Curated Developer Marketplace for Modern Assets & Tools
description: The premier distribution hub for Netroar digital assets, 2D/3D sprites, audio packages, Flutter widgets, and developer utility plugins crafted for cutting-edge game and web creators.
features: Curated developer packs, high-res UI icons, and audio mixers
Direct instant downloads with checksum verification
Seamless license management for indie developers

name: Void Otaku
description: Immersive community hub and streaming tracking portal built with cybernetic visuals, personalized watchlist recommendations, and discussion spaces for multimedia enthusiasts.
features: Slick dark-mode responsive media catalog
Community review forum and trending tracker
Lightning-fast search with instant genre filtering

name: Netroar IPR Portal
description: Enterprise-grade digital rights registry and official software signature verification gateway for all software, libraries, and multimedia assets published by Netroar Studios.
features: Cryptographic checksum and binary hash signature verification
Official certificate issuing and copyright ledger
Tamper-proof software authenticity check for clients
